verdict.rationale: Rippling documents creating Bearer API tokens under Tools → Developer → API Tokens. Each token's access is the intersection of the owner's permission profile and the token's scopes, which gives scoped, least-privilege credentials an agent can use against the v2 REST API. OAuth 2.0 is also available for App Shop apps. Missing for 10: an enumerated scope catalog, token expiry/rotation/revocation details, an agent-specific credential type, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
